blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Alohi Robins-Hardy shed tears after helping Farm Fresh book its first-ever PVL Finals appearance. While she was overcome with emotion over how the Foxies overcame a twice-to-beat top seed Nxled, Robins-Hardy also revealed that it’s her final run in the Philippine professional league. READ: PVL: Farm Fresh ousts top seed Nxled for historic Finals berth “I am retiring. I need to move on to the next chapter of my life,” said Robins-Hardy. “I’m old. My body is over it.
